title: Exactness of the coefficient-stage pair functor
statement: For a stage-system morphism F between the general rational coefficient stages on arbitrary schemes V and W [def-weil-algebraically-closed-coefficients], and finite exact data h of [def-sf-qbar-localization-finite-data], there is an integer CommShift structure s on F.functor such that the functor is additive and triangulated and every F.ιCompFunctorIso E commutes with shifts using h.shift E.

proof.text: A category with binary biproducts has a unique preadditive structure. Identify the general colimit preadditive structure with the upstream one and apply the proved additive stage-system functor instance. Every distinguished triangle is isomorphic to an included finite-stage triangle. The inclusion comparison identifies its image with the included finite functor image, so finite exactness and triangle-isomorphism invariance give exactness.

theorem sfLocalizationExactDescent {V W : Scheme.{u}}
    (F : (stageSystem l Ω V).Morphism (stageSystem l Ω W))
    (h : SfLocalizationFiniteExact l Ω F) :
    ∃ s : F.functor.CommShift ℤ,
      letI := s
      F.functor.Additive ∧ F.functor.IsTriangulated ∧
        ∀ E : Index l Ω,
          let := h.shift E
          NatTrans.CommShift (F.ιCompFunctorIso E).hom ℤ
